Tajweed — design 1 (round 1)

Design 1 in one file: the three colour directions — A emerald and gold, B teal and sand, C “mushaf” — each with a light and a dark theme, on every screen; the first launch on one screen; the mushaf pages exactly as printed in six Quran fonts; the reading view by surah; the player; the Sources; and the Lives sections (prophets, Companions, Rightly Guided Caliphs). All 22 languages. Prayer time, reading position and reciter are sample data; every Quran word is from the verified files. Designs 2 and 3: round 2, round 3.
